articles.summary: BEIJING , Aug. 20, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Limited (" Kingsoft Cloud " or the "Company") (NASDAQ: KC and HKEX: 3896), a leading cloud service provider in China , today announced its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2025 .
